pdf_page_count reads the page count of a PDF without rendering a page

```python title="Python"
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import pdf_page_count

def main() -> None:
    pdf_bytes = Path("pdf/sample_contract.pdf").read_bytes()
    result = pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes)
    print(result)

main()
```
